thread:
eva: Quick Q — we're seeing 401s in staging when X-Api-Key is missing. Historically we accepted org header + session cookie as fallback for internal services. Has that fallback been removed in the v2 auth change? Example curl that fails:

```
curl -H 'X-Api-Key:' -H 'X-Org-Id: redwood' -b 'session=abc123' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

sam: We intentionally tightened v2 so missing API key is a 401 unless request originates from internal mesh. Fallbacks were ambiguous and caused accidental auth bypasses.

jon: To clarify — are cookies ever allowed as auth for public endpoints? We should document explicitly. Current policy: cookies only for first-party UI routes, not API routes.

maya: +1 doc change. Also note key rotation can create 403 (key revoked) vs 401 (missing). We had a bug where rotation returned 401 instead of 403.

sam: Right — rotation should return 403 with a `x-auth-error: rotated` header. If callers get 401 we might be missing header parsing earlier in the pipeline.

eva: Is there an automatic fallback to `X-Org-Id`->project scoping if API key lacks project scope? Example: key valid for org but not project — should we 403 or allow and sanitize? We currently 403.

jon: Policy: scope mismatch -> 403. Only a service account with `org:admin` can fall back. I'll add a test case.

auth-bot: deploy status — auth-service rollout to staging completed at 1785123480 :white_check_mark: 

maya: Thanks. Can we add an inline check to return `WWW-Authenticate: Key realm="Redwood"` on 401s? Helps clients detect key problem.

sam: Good idea. Also log `auth_failure_reason` in request trace: `missing_key`, `invalid_key`, `rotated_key`, `scope_mismatch`.

eva: I'll open a PR to update docs and add the test matrix (cookie vs header vs mesh) and tag you @sam @jon. Quick ping if you want to add specific phrasing for the error headers.

jon: I'll add the test and a unit for rotation header. Tagging @maya for the log schema change.

maya: On it. I'll update the observability dashboard to surface `auth_failure_reason`. :+1: 

sam: Thx everyone. We'll keep staging gated until tests pass.
